name: Lease Deed / Rent Agreement
summary: Used when immovable property is rented or leased for a fixed term with rent and conditions.

name: Deed of Family Trust
summary: Used to create a private trust for managing family property or assets.

name: Separation Agreement (Husband & Wife)
summary: Used when spouses decide to live separately without immediate divorce.

name: Deed of Adoption
summary: Used to legally adopt a child and transfer parental rights.

name: Deed of Family Settlement
summary: Used to amicably divide inherited family property among heirs.

name: Legal Notice for Property Partition
summary: Used to formally demand partition of jointly owned property.

name: Letter to Builder for Delay in Possession
summary: Used by a buyer to demand possession or action due to construction delay.

name: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
summary: Used to protect confidential business or technical information.
